text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Alright, finished! Lyrics that'll spread 
the word about local specialties to the 
whole world!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Catchy lyrics that anyone of any age or 
gender can sing along to, with a truly 
approachable feel!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho-ho~ surf clams~. A bursting texture, 
surf clams~♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, it's just a song about surf 
clams... *sigh* I need to rethink this...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Hokko Tarumae ended up running in 
circles from being far too serious.
